title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
statement: Given a 1-indexed sorted array of integers numbers and a target, return the 1-indexed indices [i, j] (i < j) of the two numbers that add up to target. Exactly one solution exists.
hints: Use two pointers starting at both ends of the sorted array.
If the sum is too small, move the left pointer right; if too large, move the right pointer left.
Return 1-indexed positions once the sum matches the target.
